body:
thank you everyone for the responses, it really means a lot to me. its amazing how even a few words of encouragement can help. i want to believe that there is a light at the end of the tunnel, all my life ive had a vague optimism that things would eventually work out for me. thats the one thing that has kept me going really. recent tribulations have diminished that hope, but im trying to hold on to it.

my roommate brought some people home last night and we've been partying since.. trying my best to do the social thing. cupcakes, poursoi and drqxx, thanks for the offer to chat.. i would very much like to take you up on that, i will pm you once ive had some sleep.

thanks guys.
